nodes.description: Public total token supply counter, updated in createTokens and read by totalSupply().
Owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; receives all contributed ether via owner.transfer.
Mapping of token balances, written by createTokens, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping used by approve, allowance and transferFrom.
Hard cap on total minted tokens checked in createTokens.
Constant conversion rate (500 tokens per wei) used to compute minted tokens.
Payable fallback function that forwards to createTokens().
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender; no access control restriction.
Payable minting function: computes tokens, checks maxTokens cap, credits balances, mints supply and forwards msg.value to owner.
Constant function returning _totalSupply.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add.
Allowance-based transfer that incorrectly debits balances[msg.sender] instead of balances[_from].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without zeroing prior allowance.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder, spender, allowance owner and force-fed into the transferFrom debit path.
External ether transfer owner.transfer(msg.value) executed after balance/supply updates; owner may be a contract with a reentrant fallback.
Wrong-state arithmetic: balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) mutates the caller balance rather than the _from balance, corrupting accounting.
Local uint256 tokens = msg.value.mul(RATE), the amount minted to the buyer.
Recipient address of transfer().
Amount of tokens to move in transfer().
Source address of transferFrom(); debited only in the require check, not in the state update.
Recipient address of transferFrom().
Amount debited/credited in transferFrom().
Address granted the allowance in approve().
Allowance amount stored in approve().
Allowance owner queried in allowance().
Allowance spender queried in allowance().
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf().

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the constructor, granting unrestricted owner privileges derived from an untrusted input.
The constructor SenseProtocol writes owner, establishing the privileged address without any access check.
Constructor execution is triggered by msg.sender, which becomes the owner.
The payable fallback function forwards all calls to createTokens().
createTokens() is invoked by msg.sender and keys balance credit on the caller.
createTokens() performs the external value transfer to owner, which can re-enter the payable fallback/createTokens before state is consistent.
owner.transfer(msg.value) sends ether to the stored owner address; a contract owner can execute a reentrant fallback.
RATE is read in createTokens to convert msg.value into minted tokens.
maxTokens is read in createTokens to cap the minted supply.
balances[msg.sender] is credited in createTokens with the caller-controlled key.
The locally computed tokens amount is added into balances[msg.sender].
The locally computed tokens amount is added into _totalSupply.
transfer() is called by msg.sender and uses the caller as the debit source.
The _to parameter indexes the balances mapping as credit destination in transfer().
The _value parameter determines the balance debit/credit magnitude in transfer().
transfer() mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom() is called by msg.sender, which is later mistakenly used as the debit account.
The _from parameter indexes the allowed allowance mapping in the transferFrom require check.
The _to parameter indexes the balances mapping as credit destination in transferFrom().
The _value parameter flows into the balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) subtraction that misroutes the debit.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key of the sub() debit instead of _from, so the caller balance is underflowed/decremented incorrectly.
transferFrom() executes the incorrect balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) arithmetic and updates state.
The faulty subtraction result is written back into the balances mapping, corrupting token accounting.
The _spender parameter indexes the nested allowed mapping in approve().
The _value parameter is written directly as the new allowance in approve().
approve() is invoked by msg.sender and grants allowance keyed on the caller.
The _owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in the allowance() view.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in the allowance() view.
The _owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
approve() mutates the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
